2608.14379.title: Reflex: Enabling Fast and Predictive Vision-Language-Action Models for Reaction-Critical Manipulation
2608.14379.paper_summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently achieved promising performance in robotic manipulation. However, existing benchmarks mainly evaluate generalization on static manipulation tasks and largely overlook dynamic interaction scenarios. To address this gap, we present ReflexBench, a benchmark for reaction-critical manipulation. ReflexBench contains six dynamic tasks and introduces an evaluation framework that decouples simulator stepping from robot control while supporting configurable latency under synchronous and asynchronous inference. Building upon ReflexBench, we propose ReflexVLA, an efficient VLA model designed for reaction-critical manipulation without large-scale robot-data pretraining. ReflexVLA enhances temporal reasoning through latent future prediction and multi-frame temporal fusion within the vision backbone, while reducing deployment latency through batched visual encoding and CUDA Graph replay. Experiments show that ReflexVLA consistently improves dynamic manipulation performance while maintaining competitive accuracy on standard static manipulation benchmarks, and real-world experiments further demonstrate its effectiveness under practical deployment conditions. Project website: https://reflexvla.github.io
2608.14379.paper_summary_zh: 視覺-語言-行動 (VLA) 模型最近在機器人操作方面取得了令人鼓舞的表現。<lb/>然而，現有的基準主要評估靜態操作任務上的泛化能力，並在很大程度上忽視了動態互動場景。<lb/>為了解決這一差距，我們提出了 ReflexBench，一個針對反應關鍵操作的基準。<lb/>ReflexBench 包含六個動態任務，並引入了一個評估框架，將模擬器步進與機器人控制解耦，同時支持在同步和異步推理下的可配置延遲。<lb/>基於 ReflexBench，我們提出了 ReflexVLA，一個高效的 VLA 模型，旨在進行反應關鍵操作，而無需大規模的機器人數據預訓練。<lb/>ReflexVLA 通過潛在未來預測和視覺骨幹內的多幀時間融合來增強時間推理，同時通過批量視覺編碼和 CUDA Graph 重放來減少部署延遲。<lb/>實驗表明，ReflexVLA 在提高動態操作性能的同時，仍能在標準靜態操作基準上保持競爭力的準確性，而現實世界的實驗進一步證明了其在實際部署條件下的有效性。<lb/>項目網站：https://reflexvla.github.io
